# Desktop video edition

A second build of Movie Maker with a smaller form: Desktop video and Palettized video only
(no Unlocks, VGA, Amiga or X16 output type choices).  Same engine and UI code as the full Maker.

* Build:  `qb64pe -x MovieMakerDesk.bas`   (the full Maker is still `MakeX16Movie.bas`)
* Form:   `MovieMakerDesk.frm`, `MM_IDS_DESK.BI`, `MM_DESKLAY.BI`  -- generated by `tools/gen_form_desk.py`
  (it reads `tools/gen_form.py` for the control names; regenerate with `python3 tools/gen_form_desk.py .` from this folder)
* The shared code uses `$If DESK_EDITION = TRUE Then ... $Else ... $End If` at a few places
  (MM_FRONT.BM, MM_UI.BM).  `MakeX16Movie.bas` sets `DESK_EDITION = FALSE`, `MovieMakerDesk.bas` sets it TRUE.
* Palettized video is the standard X16 bitmap type at a custom size (NO_LIMITS on), so it follows the
  X16 frame rate limits, as in the full Maker.
